title: Malformed JSON body returns 500 instead of 400
evidence: src/middleware.ts:79 next(new Error('Invalid JSON')) has no `type`, so handleError (src/middleware.ts:65-66) falls through to 500 Internal server error
suggestion: Tag the parse error as type 'validation' (or return 400 directly) in parseBody

title: POST/PUT without a JSON Content-Type crash with 500 instead of 400
evidence: src/middleware.ts:82-83 leaves req.body undefined for non-JSON requests; validateBook(undefined) at src/middleware.ts:7 dereferences input.title -> TypeError -> 500
suggestion: Default req.body to {} or use express.json(); guard validators against a non-object input

title: Tests re-wire their own app instead of exercising src/index.ts
evidence: src/__tests__/books.test.ts:39-49 createApp() duplicates the /health route and middleware; src/index.ts:22 calls app.listen() at import time so it can't be imported by tests
suggestion: Export the app without listening (listen only under require.main === module) and test the real app

title: Tests depend on execution order and shared DB state
evidence: src/__tests__/books.test.ts:161,176,192 assume book id 1 created by the POST test at :84; DELETE test removes it
suggestion: Seed fixtures per test (beforeEach) so tests are independent

title: Unused/shadowed `path` import and CommonJS require() in TS module
evidence: src/database.ts:3 imports path, then :27 and :43 shadow it with require('path'); :42 require('fs')
suggestion: Use the top-level ES imports for path and fs

title: Tests use the production books.db file and delete it
evidence: src/__tests__/books.test.ts:53 resetDb() unlinks books.db (src/database.ts:44-45); getDb customPath/':memory:' is never used by tests
suggestion: Point tests at ':memory:' or a temp path via getDb(customPath)

title: Create requires year and isbn too (spec only mandates title and author)
evidence: src/middleware.ts:15-23 rejects missing year/isbn; src/database.ts:15-16 NOT NULL
suggestion: Acceptable stricter-than-spec behaviour; document it in README

title: idiomatic scorer returned 0.0 for readable, conventional Express code
suggestion: Check the idiomatic scorer for a parse/timeout default on this run before trusting the metric
